name: WC Woodworks, Hardwoods, & Sawmill
description: Welcome to Wood Crafting Woodworks. We are a small, family-owned and operated, specialty hardwood lumber supplier located in Ocala, Florida. We’ve been in business since 1987, initially building custom furniture and cabinetry, we have grown into North Central Florida’s largest overall inventory of traditional domestic and tropical exotic hardwoods. We’re also proud to offer furniture repair, custom fabrication, and specialized milling service with our on-site sawmill. We encourage you to visit our location where you can peruse the lumber racks and select exactly what your project requires. Our onsite production facility allows us to dimension lumber into your unique specifications. Here at WC Woodworks every attempt is made to help our customers find the right materials to make their project exceptional. With more than 40 species in stock, your knowledge of our inventory is invaluable.

name: WG Carlough Woodworking
description: Woodworking has been a passion of mine since high school.  I began designing pieces and collecting tools in 1974.  In 1981 while still in college at William Penn, I began designing furniture by commission while completing my Industrial Arts degree.  In time my shop and type of work I did grew.  For thirty years I taught a variety of high school shop classes. Besides furniture I have done extensive work with renovations and millwork for Victorian homes.
